evidence_snippets: Key actions include: setting up a Google Cloud environment and enabling the Chat API; configuring the OAuth consent screen; creating an Apps Script project from a template and linking it to the Cloud project; publishing the app with a deployment ID; and testing the app by sending a direct message.
